lane:
سنجاب

سِنْجَابٌ [a Pers. word, arabicized; in the pre sent day applied to The _squirrel;_ and particularly the _gray squirrel:_ and the _minever:_] _a certain animal, of the length of the jerboa, larger than the_ فَأْر [or _rat_], _the fur of which is of the utmost softness: furred garments are made with its skin; and the best skins of this animal are the smooth and gray._ (Dmr, TA.)

سنجابى سِنْجَابِىٌّ _Gray; of the colour of the_ سِنْجَاب.]
